moments.title: Ella Langley tops UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' has hit number one on the Official UK Singles Chart for the week ending September 10, marking her breakthrough hit after 11 weeks in the Top 10.

angles.name: New Number One
angles.copy: A massive congratulations to Ella Langley! 'Choosin' Texas' is officially the UK's No.1 single this week. What a tune!

angles.name: Country Crossover
angles.copy: Country music making waves! Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' takes the top spot. Are you loving the country crossover sound?

angles.name: Chart Rundown
angles.copy: The new UK Official Singles Chart is in! Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' is No.1. Also in the Top 10: Dolly Parton, Sam Fender & Olivia Dean. What's your favourite?

moments.title: Dolly Parton's Chart Resurgence
moments.blurb: Dolly Parton has three songs in the UK Official Singles Chart Top 10 this week: '9 to 5' at No.5, 'Jolene' at No.6, and 'Islands in the Stream' with Kenny Rogers at No.9.

angles.name: Dolly's Triple Threat
angles.copy: Pure legend! Dolly Parton has THREE songs in the UK Top 10 this week, including '9 to 5' and 'Jolene'. She's still got it!

angles.name: Timeless Hits
angles.copy: 'Islands in the Stream' with Kenny Rogers is also back in the Top 10! Which of Dolly's iconic hits is your all-time favourite?

angles.name: Chart Queen
angles.copy: A chart comeback like no other! Dolly Parton proves her timeless appeal with multiple hits in the UK Top 10. Listen to her classics now on Nation Classic Hits.
